race.comment: MY SHALONA (11) gets the nod off a clear last-start maiden win at Stanthorpe, where she was a well-supported favourite and beat Cincinnati Cobra by just over three lengths. She is third-up, has Kelsey Lenton back on, and her current-season profile gives her a great chance. ROYAL DIPLOMAT (4) has the stronger course-and-distance angle, having won at this track and distance, and his Warwick fifth is easier to assess kindly after racing wide throughout and being bumped early. EXPRESS STAR (6) hasn't been too far away of late and finds suitable assignment. SOUTHOFTHEBORDER (14) has not been winning, but his Beaudesert run two back was sound enough and he has placed twice from five starts at this distance.
